Title: As the action is announced window question

Messages.Author: Franz
Messages.Body:
What effects can be used in the "as the action is announced" window, besides the ones that are only usable in that window (Like seduction and the sleeping mind).

For instance, if my vampire is announcing a bleed action, can I use the "as the action is announced" window to cycle a Conditioning in order to try to draw a seduction? And how about cycling combat cards via Haqim Law: Retribution? Could I discard the combat cards and still be able to use Seduction or the Sleeping Mind if I draw them?

Relevant Card Texts:

[Action Modifier]
Sleeping Mind, The
Only usable as the action is announced.
[Dominate]
Choose a locked vampire. The chosen vampire cannot block this action.
[Superior Dominate]
During this action, minions cannot unlock.

[Master]
Haqim's Law: Retribution
Put this card in play. During a bleed action, an Banu Haqim you control can discard a combat card to get +1 bleed.

[Action Modifier]
Conditioning
Only usable during a bleed action.
[Dominate]
+2 bleed (limited).
[Superior Dominate]
+3 bleed (limited).

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Franz wrote:
> What effects can be used in the "as the action is announced" window, besides the ones that are only usable in that window (Like seduction and the sleeping mind).
>
Any effect pertaining to the action being taken, but not playing cards (unless they allow it).

> Franz wrote:
> For instance, if my vampire is announcing a bleed action, can I use the "as the action is announced" window to cycle a Conditioning in order to try to draw a seduction?
>
No, it's playing a card that lacks the "usable as the action is announced."
www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/77581-action-modifiers-played-at-beginning-and-end-of-an-action#94652

> Franz wrote:
> And how about cycling combat cards via Haqim Law: Retribution? Could I discard the combat cards and still be able to use Seduction or the Sleeping Mind if I draw them?
>
Yes. See also Pentex(TM) Loves You or Barrens.
